thread:
rachel: preflight check for tonight's rollout. target order US -> EU -> APAC. change window 21:00-23:00 PT. canary steps: 1% -> 5% -> 25% -> full. APAC manual hold due to cooling window.
omar: warm pools look OK but EU headroom low. current free: US 140/300, EU 45/120, APAC 18/80. keep APAC locked until EU passes 25%.
ops-bot: capacity snapshot: us-west-2 free=140 total=300; eu-west-1 free=45 total=120; ap-northeast-1 free=18 total=80. command: `opsctl capacity --regions us,eu,apac`
keiko: monitoring thresholds set. rollback if error_rate > 1% sustained 5m OR p95 up > 150ms for 3m. I'll push alerts.
rachel: @deploy-bot start US canary at 1% pinned to v1.2.3, fallback v1.2.2-slot.
deploy-bot: canary started: id cb-2955554321 region=us percent=1 version=v1.2.3 fallback=v1.2.2
omar: enable KV warmup for canary and set max_batch_size to 32 for canary slice.
rachel: KV warmup cmd: `curl -X POST https://infra/cache/warm -d '{"canary":"cb-2955554321","regions":["us"]}'`
keiko: 10m check: p95=210ms, error_rate=0.09%, gpu_util=72%  green to progress after 10m more.
ops-bot: thermal pass in US. EU marginal. APAC cooling window at 02:00 local, manual hold maintained.
deploy-bot: gating: waiting 10m stable before stepping to 5% in US.
keiko: 21m mark: US at 5% stable. error_rate=0.2%, p95=235ms. ok to queue EU at 1% but require operator manual approve for EU.
omar: queue EU 1% but keep APAC locked. release-manager prepare brief for #announcements once EU 1% starts.
release-manager: draft msg: "v1.2.3 rollout: US 5% stable; EU queued 1%; APAC manual hold. Support doc + rollback steps linked."
rachel: rollback snippet if needed: `redwoodctl rollout cancel cb-2955554321 && redwoodctl promote --version v1.2.2 --region us`
keiko: final: watching for p95 jumps and error deltas. will escalate immediately on any sustained signal. next check-in +30m or sooner on alarms. :thumbsup:
